answer_1.quote: We assess the performance of the proposed depth method under various configurations using OPT-1.3B as the language model... Five diverse datasets spanning various everyday domains are employed: News-like text from the C4 dataset..., news articles from the XSum dataset..., prompted stories from the Reddit WritingPrompts dataset..., Wikipedia paragraphs from SQuAD contexts..., and long-form answers written by human experts in the PubMedQA dataset.

answer_2.quote: The quality of the watermarked output was assessed using perplexity with an oracle model of OPT-1.3B, which quantifies the divergence between the original distribution of output and that of our watermarked model.
